name: Angry Grief-Bound
description: This Grief-Bound is rage that searches for a guilty face. It hunts emotional repetition rather than flesh alone, and it grows more coherent whenever the Expedition reenacts the behavior that created it.
primarySource: Hospice accounts, survivor interviews, and censored temple memoranda
experiencedSigns: A memory repeated by people who were not present; food spoiling only after it is counted; camp chairs facing an empty place; wounds aching in response to an unrelated argument.

howToDefeat: Prepare Before Contact - Prepare resistance or mitigation for necrotic damage. - Agree on verbal and physical contact signals before entry. Withdraw When Withdraw or change the objective when its full multiattack reaches the support line; resources fall below half before the arena mechanic is solved. habitat: Their territory accumulates symbolic objects. Destroying every object can strengthen the entity by confirming its loss; identifying the central memory is safer. Grief-Bound are emotional deaths that found enough matter or Resonance to keep moving. They are not ordinary ghosts. Each is a self-reinforcing need that hunts situations capable of repeating the moment that made it. Some can be quieted, redirected, or released if the original loss is understood. False promises often produce a stronger return.
